title: ASTU Software Engineering MCQs
source: ASTU Software Eng.pdf — Software Engineering MCQ bank

focusGuide.Software Engineering: SDLC phases, process models (Waterfall, Spiral, RAD, Agile), and 4GT.
focusGuide.Project Management: COCOMO, estimation, metrics, risk management, and configuration management.
focusGuide.Software Testing: Black-box testing, maintenance testing, and quality models.
focusGuide.General: Structured analysis, DFD notation, and software standards.

questions.text: What is the first step in the software development lifecycle?
questions.concept: Key idea (Software Engineering): Preliminary Investigation and Analysis

questions.text: What does the study of an existing system refer to?
questions.concept: Key idea (Software Engineering): System Analysis

questions.text: Which of the following is involved in the system planning and designing phase of the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC)?
questions.concept: Key idea (Software Engineering): All of the above

questions.text: What does RAD stand for?
questions.concept: Key idea (Software Engineering): Rapid Application Development

questions.text: Which of the following prototypes does not associated with Prototyping Model?
questions.concept: Key idea (Software Engineering): Diagonal Prototype

questions.text: The major drawback of RAD model is __________.
questions.concept: Key idea (Software Engineering): Both (a) & (c)

questions.text: Which of the following does not relate to Evolutionary Process Model?
questions.concept: Key idea (Software Architecture): All of the above

questions.text: What is the major drawback of the Spiral Model?

options.text: Doesn't work well for smaller projects
Additional functionalities are added later on

questions.concept: Key idea (Software Architecture): Doesn't work well for smaller projects

questions.text: Model selection is based on __________.
questions.concept: Key idea (Software Engineering): All of the above

questions.text: Which of the following option is correct?

options.text: The prototyping model facilitates the reusability of components.
RAD Model facilitates reusability of components
Both RAD & Prototyping Model facilitates reusability of components

questions.concept: Key idea (Software Engineering): Both RAD & Prototyping Model facilitates reusability of components

questions.text: Which of the following models doesn't necessitate defining requirements at the earliest in the lifecycle?
questions.concept: Key idea (Software Engineering): Spiral & Prototyping

questions.text: When the user participation isn't involved, which of the following models will not result in the desired output?
questions.concept: Key idea (Software Engineering): Prototyping & RAD

questions.text: Which of the following model will be preferred by a company that is planning to deploy an advanced version of the existing software in the market?
questions.concept: Key idea (Software Engineering): Both (b) and (c)

questions.text: Arrange the following activities for making a software product by utilizing 4GT. I. Design strategy II. Transformation into product III. Implementation IV. Requirement gathering
questions.concept: Key idea (Software Engineering): 4, 1, 3, 2

questions.text: Which of the following is an example of Black Box and Functional Processing?
questions.concept: Key idea (Software Testing): Fourth Generation Language

questions.text: __________ is identified as fourth generation language.
questions.concept: Key idea (Software Engineering): Unix shell

questions.text: The productivity of a software engineer can be reduced by using a 4GT.
questions.concept: Key idea (Software Engineering): False

questions.text: Which of the following is the main advantage of deploying a 4GT model for producing small-scale products, programs, and applications?

options.text: The productivity of software engineers is improved.
The time required for developing software is reduced.
CASE tools and code generators help the 4GT model by providing a credible solution to their problems.

questions.concept: Key idea (Software Engineering): The time required for developing software is reduced.

questions.text: Which of the following model has a major downfall to a software development life cycle in terms of the coding phase?
questions.concept: Key idea (Software Architecture): 4GT Model

questions.text: Which of the following falls under the category of software products?
questions.concept: Key idea (Software Engineering): Customized, Generic

questions.text: Software maintenance costs are expensive in contrast to software development.
questions.concept: Key idea (Software Engineering): True

questions.text: Which of the following activities of the generic process framework delivers a feedback report?
questions.concept: Key idea (Software Engineering): Deployment

questions.text: Which of the following refers to internal software equality?
questions.concept: Key idea (Software Engineering): Reusability

questions.text: RUP is abbreviated as __________, invented by a division of __________.
questions.concept: Key idea (Software Architecture): Rational Unified Process, IBM

questions.text: The RUP can be defined based on three main perspectives, i.e., static, dynamic & practice. What is the purpose of static perspective?

options.text: It recommends some good practices that be included while carrying out the process.
It displays all the enacted process activities.
It portrays the phases that the model has entered over a specific time.

questions.concept: Key idea (Software Architecture): It displays all the enacted process activities.

questions.text: Which one of the following activities is not recommended for software processes in software engineering?
questions.concept: Key idea (Software Engineering): Software Verification

questions.text: Arrange the following activities to form a general software engineering process model. I. Manufacture II. Maintain III. Test IV. Install V. Design VI. Specification
questions.concept: Key idea (Software Engineering): 6, 5, 1, 3, 4, 2

questions.text: The agile software development model is built based on __________.
questions.concept: Key idea (Software Engineering): Both Incremental and Iterative Development

questions.text: On what basis is plan-driven development different from that of the software development process?

options.text: Based on the iterations that occurred within the activities.
Based on the output, which is derived after negotiating in the software development process.
Based on the interleaved specification, design, testing, and implementation activities.

questions.concept: Key idea (Software Engineering): Based on the iterations that occurred within the activities.

questions.text: Which of the following activities is not applicable to agile software development?

options.text: Producing only the essential work products.
Utilizing the strategy of incremental product delivery.
Abolishing the project planning and testing.

questions.concept: Key idea (Software Engineering): Abolishing the project planning and testing.

questions.text: Which of the following framework activities are carried out in Adaptive Software Development (ASD)?

options.text: Requirements gathering, Adaptive cycle planning, Iterative development

questions.concept: Key idea (Software Engineering): Assumption, Association, Learning

questions.text: The __________ model helps in representing the system's dynamic behavior.
questions.concept: Key idea (Software Architecture): Behavioral Model

questions.text: Model-driven engineering is nothing but a theoretical concept. It can never be transmuted into a working/executable code.
questions.concept: Key idea (Software Architecture): False

questions.text: The __________ and __________ are the two major dimensions encompassed in the Spiral model.
questions.concept: Key idea (Software Architecture): Radial, Angular

questions.text: Which of the following technique is involved in certifying the sustained development of legacy systems?
questions.concept: Key idea (Software Architecture): Reverse engineering and Reengineering

questions.text: An erroneous system state that results in an unexpected system behavior is acknowledged as?
questions.concept: Key idea (Software Engineering): System error

questions.text: What is the name of the approach that follows step-by-step instructions for solving a problem?
questions.concept: Key idea (Software Engineering): An Algorithm

questions.text: Which of the following word correctly summarized the importance of software design?
questions.concept: Key idea (Software Engineering): Quality

questions.text: Which of the following methodology results in SA/SD features?
questions.concept: Key idea (Software Engineering): All of the above

questions.text: __________ is not considered as an activity of Structured Analysis (SA).

options.text: Transformation of a textual problem description into a graphic model
All the functions represented in the DFD are mapped to a module structure

questions.concept: Key idea (Project Management): All the functions represented in the DFD are mapped to a module structure

questions.text: What does a directed arc or line signify?
questions.concept: Key idea (Software Engineering): Data Flow

questions.text: What does a data store symbol in the Data Flow Diagram signify?
questions.concept: Key idea (Software Engineering): All of the above

questions.text: __________ is not a direct measure of SE process.
questions.concept: Key idea (Project Management): Efficiency

questions.text: What is the main task of project indicators?

options.text: To evaluate the ongoing project's status and track possible risks.
To evaluate the ongoing project's status.

questions.concept: Key idea (Project Management): To evaluate the ongoing project's status and track possible risks.

questions.text: What is the main intent of project metrics?

options.text: To evaluate the ongoing project's quality on a daily basis
To minimize the development schedule and evaluate the ongoing project's quality on a daily basis

questions.concept: Key idea (Project Management): To minimize the development schedule and evaluate the ongoing project's quality on a daily basis

questions.text: Name the graphical practice that depicts the meaningful changes that occurred in metrics data.
questions.concept: Key idea (Software Testing): DRE (Defect Removal Efficiency)

questions.text: Which parameters are essentially used while computing the software development cost?
questions.concept: Key idea (Project Management): All of the above

questions.text: Which of the following is an incorrect activity for the configuration management of a software system?
questions.concept: Key idea (Software Engineering): Internship management

questions.text: The project planner examines the statement of scope and extracts all-important software functions, which is known as
questions.concept: Key idea (Project Management): Decomposition

questions.text: Which of the following Is not considered as an option for achieving reliable cost and effort estimation?

options.text: The ability to translate the size estimate into human effort, calendar time, and dollars
Use relatively simple decomposition techniques to generate project cost and effort estimates.
Base estimates on similar projects that have already been completed
Use one or more empirical models for software cost and effort estimation

questions.concept: Key idea (Project Management): The ability to translate the size estimate into human effort, calendar time, and dollars

questions.text: Which of the following does not complement the decomposition techniques but offers a potential estimation approach for their impersonal growth?

options.text: Both empirical estimation models and automated estimation tools

questions.concept: Key idea (Project Management): Empirical estimation models

questions.text: Which of the following is not included in the total effort cost?

options.text: Costs of air conditioning and lighting in the office space

questions.concept: Key idea (Project Management): Costs of lunch time food

questions.text: What is developed by utilizing the historical cost function?
questions.concept: Key idea (Project Management): Algorithmic cost modeling

questions.text: Which of the following model has a misconception that systems are built by utilizing reusable components, scripts, and database programs?
questions.concept: Key idea (Software Engineering): An application-composition model

questions.text: Which of the following is used to predict the effort as a function of LOC or FP?
questions.concept: Key idea (Project Management): Both COCOMO and FP-based estimation

questions.text: Once the requirements are stabilized, the basic architecture of the software can be established. Which of the following version of the COCOMO model conforms to the given statement?
questions.concept: Key idea (Project Management): Application composition model

questions.text: Which of the following threatens the quality and timeliness of the produced software?
questions.concept: Key idea (Project Management): Technical risks

questions.text: Which of the following refers to the systematic attempt, which is implemented to ascertain the threats to any project plan?
questions.concept: Key idea (Project Management): Risk projection

questions.text: Which of the following standards is used by the aviation industry?
questions.concept: Key idea (Software Engineering): RTCADO-178B

questions.text: Third-Party Certification for software standards is based on __________.
questions.concept: Key idea (Software Engineering): Ul 1998, Second Edition
